canvas.avoid: Do not tint all content mint

textPrimary.avoid: Never lower opacity for ordinary text

focus.avoid: Never focus ring adjacent to same-color action fill without gap

disabledText.avoid: Read-only values must remain full contrast

infoInk.avoid: Do not erase warning with selection

errorInk.avoid: Do not call all partial work failure

successInk.avoid: Not fulfilled unless domain says so

photoMat.avoid: Never change PDF paper with theme

font.appearance: follow system; no new appearance settings

report.policy: Preserve pinned fixed report geometry and immutable bytes. Logo space is adopted/pending; text layout must subtract measured caption/header/footer heights, never use fixed caption clipping.

ST-DUE-OVERDUE.meaning: Business due date before Today; may coexist with Booked/Working. Not failed work or permission error.

ST-DUE-TODAY.meaning: Business due date today; no assertion that visit is already late.

ST-DUE-DUE_SOON.meaning: Tomorrow through configured horizon; Home range may explicitly include Today as aggregate.

ST-DUE-UPCOMING.meaning: Beyond horizon; not due soon merely because not overdue.

ST-DUE-NONE.meaning: Only when domain proves no active plan. Missing read is not this state.

ST-VISIT-BOOKED.meaning: Appointment exists; obligation can remain overdue.

ST-VISIT-WORKING.meaning: Durable unfinished visit; no finalized result.

ST-VISIT-FINALIZED.meaning: Immutable service record exists; not proof of fulfilled all work, safety or successful PDF.

ST-VISIT-CANCELLED.meaning: Booking cancelled, history retained; outstanding services not fulfilled.

ST-VISIT-PASSED.meaning: Derived Booked attention cue, not automatic no-show/cancellation.

ST-VISIT-PARTICIPATION_COMPLETE.meaning: Only local involvement ended; no fake final report or central completion.

ST-VISIT-DISPATCH_WITHDRAWN.meaning: Newer package removed final applicable assignment from untouched Booked work; no central cancellation.

ST-OUTCOME-PERFORMED.meaning: Human outcome for this work line; does not automatically fulfill obligation.

ST-OUTCOME-PARTLY_PERFORMED.meaning: Partial recorded work; obligation usually remains outstanding.

ST-OUTCOME-NOT_PERFORMED.meaning: Legitimate recorded outcome with required reason, not parser/save failure.

ST-OUTCOME-UNSET.meaning: No selected result; finalization blocker where required.

ST-CHECKLIST-IN_PROGRESS.meaning: Some active answer state; review still required.

ST-CHECKLIST-REVIEWED.meaning: Required active answers accounted for and acknowledged; not all OK/safety.

ST-CHECKLIST-OK.meaning: Technician answer to this item only.

ST-CHECKLIST-ISSUE_FOUND.meaning: Needs active public description; does not automatically prevent inspection fulfillment.

ST-CHECKLIST-NOT_APPLICABLE.meaning: Active reason required; inactive prior drafts retained.

ST-CHECKLIST-NOT_CHECKED.meaning: Explicit unperformed check; never equivalent to OK.

ST-CHECKLIST-UNANSWERED.meaning: No active text/value; not coerced to0.

ST-CHECKLIST-VALUE.meaning: Actual active value, with captured unit; no automatic threshold judgement.

ST-CHECKLIST-INVALID.meaning: Active required/parse error, not ordinary unanswered optional field.

ST-FOLLOWUP-OPEN.meaning: Outstanding task, may coexist with separate overdue/today cue.

ST-FOLLOWUP-RESOLVED.meaning: Explicit task resolution only; not machine certification or plan fulfillment.

ST-FOLLOWUP-CANCELLED.meaning: Reasoned task cancellation; does not prove fault repaired.

ST-MASTER-ACTIVE.meaning: Current usable record, not selected UI state.

ST-MASTER-ARCHIVED.meaning: Retained historical record; unavailable for new current work until eligible restore.

ST-MASTER-IN_SERVICE.meaning: Equipment participates in work; no Healthy claim.

ST-MASTER-RETIRED.meaning: Equipment retained outside active workflow; not hard delete.

ST-MASTER-PAUSED.meaning: Plan retains due date but stops active participation.

ST-MASTER-ENDED.meaning: No future plan obligation; not reversible enable switch.

ST-OBSERVATION-NO_ISSUE_OBSERVED.meaning: Observation within this visit only; not automatic full safety.

ST-OBSERVATION-ISSUE_OBSERVED.meaning: Dated human observation, distinct from open follow-up counts.

ST-OBSERVATION-RESOLVED_DURING_VISIT.meaning: Finding disposition with public work note, not whole-equipment certification.

ST-OBSERVATION-FOLLOWUP_NEEDED.meaning: Requires actual valid proposal/link; proposal not live until parent commit.

ST-OBSERVATION-NO_FURTHER_ACTION.meaning: Technician judgement with reason, not app endorsement.

ST-HISTORY-CURRENT.meaning: Authoritative current record/report context, not receipt.

ST-HISTORY-CORRECTION_DRAFT.meaning: Original remains current; draft retained independently.

ST-HISTORY-SUPERSEDED.meaning: Old revision retained; warning before permitted sharing, no promotion on open.

ST-HISTORY-VOIDED.meaning: No longer valid service evidence; retained view/export; ordinary share of original blocked.

ST-HISTORY-VOID_NOTICE.meaning: New public notice of invalidation; not overwritten old PDF.

ST-HISTORY-RECREATED.meaning: New rendition identity/time from preserved snapshot, not recovered original bytes.

ST-HISTORY-ENTERED_IN_ERROR.meaning: Saved contact history retained with reason under B-002.

ST-SAVE-DIRTY.meaning: Only local input buffer; not durable record.

ST-SAVE-SAVING.meaning: Actual write pending; no fabricated timestamp/progress percentage.

ST-SAVE-SAVED.meaning: Actual durable acknowledgement with time; not backed up/synchronized.

ST-SAVE-FAILED.meaning: Keep input and last durable checkpoint; priority above routine status.

ST-SAVE-RECOVERED_BUFFER.meaning: Not automatically applied to record; explicit resume/discard.

ST-SAVE-LOADING.meaning: No zero counts/empty state until read complete.

ST-SAVE-REFRESH_FAILED.english: Could not refresh — showing saved data
ST-SAVE-REFRESH_FAILED.romanian: Actualizare eșuată — se afișează datele salvate
ST-SAVE-REFRESH_FAILED.meaning: Keep previous durable list, Retry; not current fresh read claim.

ST-SAVE-EMPTY.meaning: Successful read and genuinely empty relevant dataset.

ST-SAVE-NO_RESULTS.meaning: Successful filtered empty result; Clear filters, not reset data.

ST-REPORT-NOT_GENERATED.meaning: Final record may exist without PDF.

ST-REPORT-GENERATING.meaning: Actual rendering operation; no received/sent meaning.

ST-REPORT-READY.meaning: Stored verified usable rendition exists; not delivered.

ST-REPORT-FAILED.meaning: Final record remains finalized; retry generation only.

ST-REPORT-MISSING.meaning: Recorded identity remains; recovery or explicit new rendition, not silently reconstructed original.

ST-REPORT-DRAFT.meaning: Public staged data, no external Save/Share allowed.

ST-OUTBOX-DRAFT.meaning: No successful usable export artifact; itemless Draft valid but not export-ready.

ST-OUTBOX-DISPATCHED.meaning: Usable package created/export metadata committed; NOT delivered/received/accepted.

ST-OUTBOX-CONCLUDED.meaning: Office bookkeeping only; readonly until Reopen; not technician completion.

ST-OUTBOX-MATERIAL_CHANGED.meaning: Last successful generation remains until new export; no automatic push.

ST-OUTBOX-EXPORT_STALE.meaning: Prepared material stale; no false status/generation advance.

ST-OUTBOX-NOT_READY.meaning: Itemless Draft cannot export; not inability to save Draft.

ST-IMPORT-NEW_VISIT.meaning: Eligible new local copy only after Apply.

ST-IMPORT-UPDATE.meaning: Higher generation may update same untouched eligible local Visit after review.

ST-IMPORT-ASSIGNMENT_REMOVED.meaning: Safe higher-generation removal reviewed; not delete started historical evidence.

ST-IMPORT-CONFLICT.meaning: Same identity/version different material or hard directory conflict; no overwrite.

ST-IMPORT-LOCAL_CONFLICT.meaning: Local material changed; incoming copy cannot silently rewrite.

ST-IMPORT-UPDATE_BLOCKED.meaning: Current state prevents safe update; show cause/route not fake success.

ST-IMPORT-NOT_ASSIGNED.meaning: Not applicable to this identity; leader-visible/current/conflict are not this classification.

ST-IMPORT-EXISTING_UNCHANGED.meaning: Directory same reference/fields; safe reuse without mutation.

ST-IMPORT-NEW.meaning: Proposed create-only directory entry; not durable yet.

ST-IMPORT-POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.meaning: Human identity decision needed; similar name alone not same entity.

ST-IMPORT-SKIPPED.meaning: Explicit skip with dependent scope retained in result; no partial hidden hierarchy.

ST-IMPORT-APPLIED.meaning: Actual local transaction committed; no remote acceptance/status broadcast.

ST-DOCUMENT-ASSIGNED.meaning: Package assignment, not exclusive central claim.

ST-DOCUMENT-EVERYONE.meaning: Empty explicit assignees means participant union, not nobody.

ST-DOCUMENT-LEADER_OBSERVE.meaning: Visible for overview, not automatically mandatory documentation.

ST-DOCUMENT-DOCUMENT_LOCAL.meaning: Local responsibility selected; may strictly match current local obligation.

ST-DOCUMENT-DEFERRED.meaning: Local handoff only; acceptance and exclusivity not proven.

ST-RECOVERY-FULL_VERIFIED.meaning: Actual written package read back/verified against captured full snapshot; later changes may exist.

ST-RECOVERY-WRITTEN_UNVERIFIED.meaning: External write acknowledgement only, not verified full recovery coverage.

ST-RECOVERY-INCOMPLETE.meaning: Known missing-file manifest explicitly acknowledged; never Full backup.

ST-RECOVERY-INVALID.meaning: Cannot safely import/replace; retain current dataset.

ST-RECOVERY-UNLOCK_FAILED.meaning: Wrong secret or damaged data not distinguished without evidence; no live replacement.

ST-RECOVERY-CHANGED.meaning: New business edits after snapshot, not merely after slow write finished.

ST-RECOVERY-REPLACING.meaning: Short atomic phase; dismiss/cancel temporarily disabled; recoverable swap.

ST-RECOVERY-RESTORED.meaning: Dataset replacement succeeded; local reminders/Calendar reset Off; not merge/sync.

ST-RECOVERY-RESTRICTED.meaning: Business dataset not safe to open; preserve files, expose safe recovery only.

ST-RECOVERY-FILE_MISSING.meaning: Specific retained reference unavailable; no guessed image or silent omission.

ST-CALENDAR-OFF.meaning: Local integration disabled; prior external events can remain.

ST-CALENDAR-PERMISSION.meaning: Actual Calendar read/write capability missing; Visit unaffected.

ST-CALENDAR-CHOOSE.meaning: Need actual writable destination; no invented default Google account.

ST-CALENDAR-UNAVAILABLE.meaning: Previously selected provider missing/unavailable; keep bindings/error truth.

ST-CALENDAR-ACTIVE.meaning: One-way projection enabled, not proof of cloud sync.

ST-CALENDAR-SYNCED.meaning: Actual managed local provider link; external changes do not update ServiceLoop.

ST-CALENDAR-MISSING.meaning: External event deleted; explicit Recreate, not automatic duplicate.

ST-CALENDAR-SUPPRESSED.meaning: Explicit per-visit suppression; Add required to resume projection.

ST-CALENDAR-DELETE_PENDING.meaning: Business cancellation committed; provider removal still needs retry.

ST-CALENDAR-INELIGIBLE.meaning: Date-only/non-Booked or otherwise ineligible; no all-day/labour duration fiction.

ST-CALENDAR-NEEDS_ATTENTION.meaning: Actual store/provider problem; not business failure.

ST-NOTIFY-OFF.meaning: Local delivery intent Off, saved preferred schedule may remain.

ST-NOTIFY-BLOCKED.meaning: User intent retained; actual permission/channel prevents posting.

ST-NOTIFY-RETRY.meaning: Actual local scheduling error; no precise/exact promise.

ST-NOTIFY-APPROXIMATE.meaning: Eligible ordinary delivery; timing may be delayed.

ST-NOTIFY-REQUESTED.meaning: Notify request made, not proof of display/hearing.

ST-NOTIFY-SUPPRESSED.meaning: No stale/past/ineligible reminder posted; underlying work state unchanged.

ST-UI-SELECTED.meaning: Mint background plus checkbox/outline; never completion.

ST-UI-UNSELECTED.meaning: Row opening remains separate from selection.

ST-UI-READ_ONLY.meaning: Full-contrast retained value; not disabled/faded content.

ST-UI-DISABLED.meaning: Unavailable command only; visible reason uses normal readable text.

ST-UI-FOCUSED.meaning: 2dp outline separated by2dp surface gap; not selected state.

ST-UI-PRESSED.meaning: Momentary action feedback, no durable state change.

ST-FULFILL-ELIGIBLE.meaning: May explicitly fulfill current obligation; not prechecked automatically.

ST-FULFILL-HISTORY_ONLY.meaning: Recorded historical work without current recurrence effect.

ST-FULFILL-NO_CURRENT_OBLIGATION.meaning: No recurring obligation exists for this line.

ST-FULFILL-OUTCOME_INELIGIBLE.meaning: Partial/unperformed outcome cannot fulfill; can still record truthful visit.

ST-FULFILL-CHECKLIST_NOT_REVIEWED.meaning: Checklist review missing; go to actual item, do not infer OK.

ST-FULFILL-CURRENT_OBLIGATION_CHANGED.meaning: Revalidate exact obligation, never consume newer one by accident.
